title: mri_robust_template
description: Constructs an unbiased robust template for longitudinal volumes using an iterative method.

mov.description: Input movable volumes to be aligned to common mean/median template (at least 2 required).
mov.title: Movable Volumes

sat.description: Set outlier sensitivity manually. Higher values mean less sensitivity.
sat.title: Outlier Sensitivity

satit.description: Auto-detect good sensitivity (recommended for head or full brain scans).
satit.title: Auto-detect Sensitivity

lta.description: Output LTA transforms to template (one per input volume).
lta.title: Output Transforms

mapmov.description: Output mapped and resampled images in template space (one per input volume).
mapmov.title: Mapped Movables

mapmovhdr.description: Output header-adjusted movable images (no resampling, only vox2ras adjusted).
mapmovhdr.title: Header-adjusted Movables

weights.description: Output weight volumes in template space (0=regular, 1=outlier).
weights.title: Outlier Weights

oneminusw.description: Invert outlier weight map (0=outlier), as in earlier versions.
oneminusw.title: Invert Weights

inittp.description: Use timepoint number for spatial initialization (default: random). 0 constructs template from original volumes without initialization.
inittp.title: Initial Timepoint

fixtp.description: Map everything to initial timepoint (init TP is not resampled).
fixtp.title: Fix Timepoint

iscaleonly.description: Only perform intensity scaling (no spatial transformation).
iscaleonly.title: Intensity Scaling Only

iscaleout.description: Output final intensity scale files (will activate --iscale).
iscaleout.title: Output Intensity Scales

ixforms.description: Use initial LTA transforms on source ('id' for identity).
ixforms.title: Initial Transforms

masks.description: Input mask volumes applied to movable images.
masks.title: Input Masks

vox2vox.description: Output VOX2VOX LTA file (default is RAS2RAS).
vox2vox.title: Vox2Vox Output

leastsquares.description: Use least squares instead of robust M-estimator (for testing only).
leastsquares.title: Least Squares

noit.description: Do not iterate, just create first template.
noit.title: No Iteration

maxit.description: Maximum number of template iterations (default: 6 if >2 timepoints, 5 otherwise).
maxit.title: Max Iterations

highit.description: Maximum number of iterations on highest resolution (default: -1, use maxit).
highit.title: High Resolution Iterations

epsit.description: Stop template iterations when all transform updates fall below this value (default: -1.0, disabled).
epsit.title: Iteration Convergence Threshold

pairmaxit.description: Maximum number of iterations for pairwise registrations (default: 5).
pairmaxit.title: Pairwise Max Iterations

pairepsit.description: Stop pairwise registration iterations when transform updates fall below this value (default: 0.01).
pairepsit.title: Pairwise Convergence Threshold

subsample.description: Subsample if voxel dimension exceeds this value on all axes (default: -1, disabled).
subsample.title: Subsample Threshold

nomulti.description: Do not use multi-resolution (process highest resolution only).
nomulti.title: Disable Multi-resolution

floattype.description: Convert images to float internally (default: keep input type).
floattype.title: Convert to Float

finalnearest.description: Use nearest neighbor interpolation when creating the final average.
finalnearest.title: Nearest Neighbor Interpolation

doubleprec.description: Use double precision instead of float internally (large memory usage).
doubleprec.title: Double Precision

cras.description: Center template at average CRAS instead of average barycenter.
cras.title: Center at CRAS

seed.description: Set random seed for target selection (default: 0).
seed.title: Random Seed

allow_diff_vox_size.description: Allow input volumes with different voxel sizes.
allow_diff_vox_size.title: Allow Different Voxel Sizes
